subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The manager finally __acceded__ to his request.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"acceded"** means to agree to a request or a demand. (सहमति देना)

 
 
• **Example: **After much deliberation, the committee** acceded **to the proposal.
 
 
 
• **"Refused" **means to indicate or show that one is not willing to do something. (इंकार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She **refused** to comment on the issue.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'acceded' **is **'refused'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agreed **(सहमत होना): To have the same opinion about something.

 
 
• **Example:** We** agreed** to meet at the library.
 
 
 
• **Succumbed **(झुकना): To yield to pressure, temptation, or some other negative force.
 
 
• **Example: **He **succumbed **to the temptation of the chocolate cake.
 
 
 
• **Applied** (लागू करना): To make a formal application or request.
 
 
• **Example:** She **applied** for a job at the new company.
